segments.contextAfter: **The major version**: The first digit of a version, or *major version*, signifies breaking changes to the API that require updates to existing clients. For example, the semantic versioning specification considers renaming an existing type, removing a method, or changing a method’s signature breaking changes. This also includes any backward-incompatible bug fixes or behavioral changes of the existing API.
